name: opendss_altdss_library

support_targets.opendss: EPRI OpenDSS; online documentation is mixed-version

validation.source_review: Line/LineCode and Phase 3A passed independent QA/QC and required corrections are applied. The owner accepted Phase 3B packages 1 through 3 after independent QA/QC and architect review. Package 4 (Load) passed independent QA/QC with no blocking findings and the architect review with no required corrections to the package; that review corrected one architect-owned handoff statement (A-1) and recorded two observations (O-1, O-3). Package 5 (Capacitor) handoff is prepared from an independent read of the pinned sources and is gated on package 4 acceptance.
validation.schema_validation: tools/validate_catalogs.py passed 13/13 manifest and catalog schema pairs (Draft 2020-12 with format checking, jsonschema 4.26.0) on 2026-11-21.
validation.runtime: All ten catalogued examples ran successfully on 2026-11-21 on Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, and backend 0.14.5. Phase 3B packages 1 through 4 have readback matrices; the package-4 matrix was re-run by the architect review and matched the committed file apart from the environment block.

known_gaps: Three catalog files are still empty pending later phases: opendss_objects, python_interface_comparison, troubleshooting.

The generated altdss_python_api catalog covers object and collection classes and the AltDSS context. Non-element context interfaces, context batch proxies, and internal _str proxies are outside the catalog scope.

dss_capi.json covers Line, LineCode, LineGeometry, LineSpacing, WireData, CNData, TSData, Circuit creation, Vsource, Transformer, XfmrCode, and Load, including inherited fields used in these packages.
Transformer and XfmrCode coverage is limited to two and three windings. AutoTrans is deferred pending an owner scope decision.
LoadShape and GrowthShape property catalogs are deferred. The Load package covers the Load element and its shape-assignment behavior only.
Property-level source_refs remain partial for Line/LineCode (E-3 deferred); new element packages require per-row citations.
Fixture-based validation with IEEE 13- and 34-node circuits and golden results is planned for Phase 4; no golden fixtures exist yet.
The beta package line (AltDSS-Python 0.3.0b2 and later) is documented as future compatibility only and not validated.
EPRI online pages do not state one OpenDSS version; version-sensitive claims need release-specific confirmation.
The legacy line catalog and builder are retained for provenance and are not active inputs.
CapControl is a deferred controller catalog. The Capacitor package covers the Capacitor element and the States control hook only.
The Capacitor element has no Spectrum property, unlike Load and Vsource.

element_properties.schema.json allows undeclared row fields, so the Load catalog's enum_type and reference_class entries are unvalidated until the shared schema declares them (phase3b_load_architect_audit O-1).
next_actions: Record the owner's disposition for Phase 3B package 4 (Load); independent QA/QC and the architect review both passed with no required corrections to the package.
Deliver Phase 3B package 5 (Capacitor) per docs/handoffs/Phase_3B_Capacitor_Coder_handoff.md once the owner accepts package 4.
Declare enum_type and reference_class in the shared element schema, or drop them, so the Load row fields stop being unvalidated (architect audit O-1).
Draft the Phase 4 golden fixture layout and harness before the first fixture is added.
